Guidance for Claude Code. MAF learning repo with production PM Copilot/docs.

Setup:
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env  # then fill in OPENAI_API_KEY at minimum
python app.py --console
python app.py --server
python app.py --devui
python app.py --copilotkit
Endpoints: `POST /api/local_chat`, `POST /api/messages`, `GET /chat`, `/copilotkit`. `GRAPH_MODE=mock` default; `GRAPH_MODE=live` requires Azure credentials.

cd maf_copilotkit/agent
uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
uvicorn serve
raw_text:
Guidance for Claude Code. MAF learning repo with production PM Copilot/docs.

Setup:
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env  # then fill in OPENAI_API_KEY at minimum
python app.py --console
python app.py --server
python app.py --devui
python app.py --copilotkit
Endpoints: `POST /api/local_chat`, `POST /api/messages`, `GET /chat`, `/copilotkit`. `GRAPH_MODE=mock` default; `GRAPH_MODE=live` requires Azure credentials.

cd maf_copilotkit/agent
uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000
cd maf_copilotkit/web
pnpm install && pnpm dev
cd tmp-ag-ui
pnpm install && pnpm build
pnpm test
pnpm lint
pnpm dev
Star-topology: Triage routes to 5 specialists; specialists hand back. Triage: `maf/agents/triage.py`, no tools. Orchestration: `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py` with `HandoffBuilder`. Tools: `maf/tools/`
